title: fix(turbo): hash the ui tree root build and test inputs in the root turbo.json; guards read the live config
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYog9FzTNeBAndKHXTT

Fixes #27283
Part of #26080
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：根 `turbo.json` 的 `build`/`test` 任务现在把 ui 树根部被各 `@object-ui/*` 包真实读取的文件(`ui/tsconfig.json`、`ui/scripts/vite-*.ts`、vitest 配置与 setup 等)计入缓存键；守卫全部改读这份真实配置，删除无人读取的 `ui/turbo.objectui.json`。
- 为什么改：此前改动这些文件不会让 turbo 缓存失效，CI 或发版可能回放旧的构建产物；而守卫读的是一份停用副本，所以一直是假绿。
- 风险与回滚：所有 `@objectstack/*` 与 `@object-ui/*` 的 build/test 缓存键一次性变化(253 个中 243 个)，首轮 CI 冷构建；只改配置与测试，不改运行时代码，回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`turbo.json`(build/test 两段新增输入)→ `ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-lint-inputs.test.ts` 与 `e2e-type-check.test.ts`(两个根任务守卫改为对照 ci.yml 步骤)→ `ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-task-guard-coverage.test.ts`(任务范围收到本树)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/components --dry=json`，在该任务的 inputs 里应能看到 `../../scripts/vite-dts-explicit-extensions.ts` 与 `../../tsconfig.json`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Root `turbo.json`, option A.** `build` gains the six ui-root files every `@object-ui/*` build reads (`ui/tsconfig.json`, `ui/scripts/vite-*.ts`, `build-plugin-stylesheet.mjs`, `check-dist-completeness.mjs`, `invoked-as.mjs`, `vitest-invocation-guard.mjs`). `test` gains the seven its Vitest configuration program reads (`ui/vitest.config.mts`, `ui/vitest.setup.*`, `vitest-invocation-guard.mjs`, `test-shard-*`, `vite-*.ts`, the Console's `vitest.config.ts` and `vite.config.ts`). Each entry is required by the derived guards, which refuse an entry no package program reads.
- **Why A over B** (measured, below). B, a package-level `turbo.json` in each ui package, moves 82 of 253 build/test hashes against A's 243. But it needs 39 new files, each carrying the same list, plus a per-package config composer inside the guards. It also cannot cover the `ui` root package without a `ui/turbo.json`, which `workspace-root.mjs` would then read as the tree's own config. A keeps one list, in the file turbo reads, and the guards read it unchanged through `liveTurboConfig()`. A's recurring cost is that an edit to one of these files also invalidates the `@objectstack/*` entries. Over the last 30 days, 9 of 3513 commits on `main` touched these files.
- **Guards retargeted, no assertion loosened.** `turbo-build-inputs`, `turbo-test-inputs`, `check-dist-completeness` (its build-input case), `turbo-build-outputs-cover-published-entries`, `turbo-task-guard-coverage` and `select-type-check-scope` now read the live config. `taskInputs()` and `rootAnchoredInputs()` now default to it, and `parkedTurboConfig()` is gone.
  - `turbo-task-guard-coverage` draws its partition over the tasks turbo runs on a package of this tree: a generic task some ui manifest declares a script for, or a `PKG#TASK` override for a ui package. That set is exactly what the parked copy declared. A new liveness case pins the four guarded tasks as the floor.
  - `ui/apps/console/turbo.json` now restates the root `build.outputs`, adding `json-schema/**` and `!.next/cache/**`. The outputs guard, read against the live root, found that it narrowed them.
- **Root-task guards, rewritten against the `ci.yml` step that runs each task** (a read of `ci.yml`, no workflow edit):
  - `//#lint:root` is now a pin on `lint-ui`'s `pnpm --dir ui run lint:root` step:
    - The step exists, runs exactly the script, and has no `if:`.
    - The live `lint` task folds in no `//#` task's hash.
    - The ignored workspace groups are exactly the groups the turbo `lint` step filters in.
    - Every file ESLint walks at that scope sets the `ui` paths filter.
    - The step is the script itself, so no cache can replay it.
  - `//#type-check:e2e` gets the same pins on `type-check-ui`'s `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:e2e` step. The filter-coverage pin there is over the e2e program's files.
  - `select-type-check-scope`'s root-task case (rule item 4) runs on objectui's own shape of that task as a fixture, inputs verbatim. Under the live config there is no root task left for it to read.
- **Deleted:** `ui/turbo.objectui.json`, `PARKED_TURBO_CONFIG` and `uiTurboConfigPath()`, with its declaration and tests. After the retarget, `git grep` finds no reader.

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` on head `47d861189`, under `os-verify-lock`: `Test Files 169 passed | 2 skipped (171)`, `Tests 4900 passed | 2 skipped (4902)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. No failures, so no baseline-failure set.
- The touched reader files, untouched `origin/main` (`ad3a640e3`) vs this branch: 324/324 → 323/323. Every file keeps its count except `turbo-task-guard-coverage`, which goes 15 → 14:
  - Retired: its two cases "`//#lint:root` / `//#type-check:e2e` is exempt because turbo never caches it". They are retired under the test-deletion rule. Their duplicates are "stays uncached: the step is the script itself" (`turbo-lint-inputs.test.ts`) and "is uncached: the step is the script itself" (`e2e-type-check.test.ts`). Both pin the property on the CI step that actually runs each task.
  - Added: one case, the partition-scope liveness.
- `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts`: exit 0, and `--listFilesOnly` shows all five changed test and helper files in that program. `eslint` over the changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/scripts/select-type-check-scope.mjs` has no caller in any root workflow: `helpers/root-ci.ts` records the selector as not ported. So its test holds a function nothing runs in the monorepo. Noted, not filed.
- First `ablation-replace` attempt (teeth 2 below) was refused by the tool: the replacement text was already counted inside the anchor, so nothing ran and the restore was proven. It was re-run with `--delete`.

## Verification

`pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/components --dry=json`: hash `587292e7374b7756`, out-of-package inputs only `../../../scripts/check-dts-emitted.mjs`, `../../../scripts/invoked-as.mjs`, `../../../scripts/tsup-drop-sources-content.mjs`. `ui/packages/components/vite.config.ts:14-15` imports `../../scripts/vite-dts-explicit-extensions.ts` and `../../scripts/vite-dts-fail-on-type-errors.ts`.

After: hash `ba59da9212bafc37`. The same 3, plus `../../tsconfig.json`, `../../scripts/build-plugin-stylesheet.mjs`, `check-dist-completeness.mjs`, `invoked-as.mjs`, `vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` and the nine `../../scripts/vite-*.ts`.
</details>

144 assertions red in 8 files: `turbo-build-inputs` 37, `turbo-test-inputs` 39, `turbo-task-guard-coverage` 55, `turbo-lint-inputs` 5 (the `//#lint:root` block), `e2e-type-check` 4 (the wiring block), `select-type-check-scope` 2, `check-dist-completeness` 1, `turbo-build-outputs-cover-published-entries` 1 (Console narrowing the root outputs). The slice-2 reading was 147, against an older tree. On this branch: 0 red.
</details>

- A (this PR): 243 changed. ui build 41/41, ui test 41/41, objectstack build 81/85, objectstack test 80/85 (the unchanged ones carry their own package-specific task entry), gen:migration-registry 0/1.
- B (prototype: `$TURBO_EXTENDS$` package configs in 39 ui packages plus the Console's, measured and then deleted): 82 changed. ui build 41/41, ui test 41/41, objectstack 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Guard teeth: ablation-replace on turbo.json, restored to the HEAD blob 87fdc7914587</summary>

1. Deleting the `build` entries `$TURBO_ROOT$/ui/scripts/vite-*.ts` and `build-plugin-stylesheet.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0) made `turbo-build-inputs` go `22 failed | 21 passed (43)`, naming the Console, components and fields programs.
2. Adding `"dependsOn": ["//#lint:root"]` to `lint` made `turbo-lint-inputs` go `1 failed | 51 passed (52)`, on the case "folds no root-task hash into any package `lint`".
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates on 47d861189</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 31 commands. Each was run with its exit captured before any pipe: 30 exit 0, and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3. That is PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's built `dist/`, and only the seven ui-consumer closures were built here, so it is NOT MEASURED locally and CI owns it. `--ran`: `31 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 30 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, 0 anchored files.
